title: 'Checks'
description: 'Every built-in check of x18n check, with its default severity.'
---

<!-- Generated by docs/scripts/generate.ts from the source code. Do not edit. -->

A check reads the project and reports diagnostics. A diagnostic is one reported issue with a code, a severity and optional fixes. `x18n check` runs every check, and the editor shows the same diagnostics.

The `recommended` set is every check that is not `off` below. Override the severity of a check in `checks`:

```ts [x18n.config.ts]
import { defineConfig } from '@x18n/core'

export default defineConfig({
  checks: {
    'unused-key': 'error',
    'identical-to-source': 'warning',
    'key-style': ['warning', { case: 'camel' }],
  },
})
```

A severity is `error`, `warning`, `info`, `hint` or `off`. `strict: true` (or `x18n check --strict`) turns every warning into an error. `ignoreKeys` removes keys from every check.

| Check | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [missing-key](/checks/missing-key) | `error` | A usage whose key is not defined in the source locale. |
| [invalid-syntax](/checks/invalid-syntax) | `error` | Message syntax errors (ICU, linked messages, nesting). |
| [placeholder-mismatch](/checks/placeholder-mismatch) | `error` | Target value placeholders differ from the source value. |
| [key-conflict](/checks/key-conflict) | `error` | A key that is both a leaf and a parent, or is duplicated across files of one locale. |
| [missing-translation](/checks/missing-translation) | `warning` | A source-locale key that target locales lack, or a plural form their language needs. One diagnostic per key, at the source entry. |
| [stale-translation](/checks/stale-translation) | `warning` | A translation that last changed before its source message, by the history providers (git). |
| [empty-translation](/checks/empty-translation) | `warning` | A message with an empty string value. |
| [redundant-translation](/checks/redundant-translation) | `warning` | A message in a locale with a fallback that equals the message it falls back to, so it can be removed. |
| [unused-key](/checks/unused-key) | `warning` | A key with no usage, after keysInUse, derived keys and dynamic prefixes. |
| [locale-code-conflict](/checks/locale-code-conflict) | `warning` | Locale codes that differ only in spelling, such as zh_CN and zh-CN. |
| [dynamic-key](/checks/dynamic-key) | `off` | A fully dynamic key that no check can follow. |
| [identical-to-source](/checks/identical-to-source) | `off` | A target value that equals the source value. |
| [key-style](/checks/key-style) | `off` | A key that does not match a naming rule (options: case, pattern). |
| [hard-string](/checks/hard-string) | `info` | A hard-coded string that should probably be a message. On with `extract.autoDetect`. |
| [glossary](/checks/glossary) | `off` | A glossary term translated differently from the glossary. |
| [invalid-resource](/checks/invalid-resource) | `error` | A locale file or source file that x18n failed to read, parse or scan. |

The reporters of `x18n check --reporter` are `pretty`, `json`, `markdown`, `github`, `sarif`. See [CLI and x18n check](/surfaces/cli#x18n-check-reporters).
